# Vendored GenOffice engine sources

Selective vendor of [GenOffice](https://github.com/bluelephant825/genoffice)
(fork of [genspark-ai/genoffice](https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice)),
pinned to commit `f2c3d0879df29622d5a447935d2b4aeac033544d`. Apache-2.0; see
`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `LICENSE-UNICODE.txt` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` in this
directory.

## What is vendored

The minimal transitive source closure needed for DOCX editing, PDF content
editing and local PDF→DOCX conversion:

- `packages/docx-engine/` — OOXML parse/patch/save engine
- `packages/pptx-engine/` — only the files the closure needs (docx-engine and
  pdf2docx import parts of it; no PPTX editing surface is wired up)
- `packages/pdf2docx/` — bytes-in/bytes-out `convertPdfToDocx` pipeline plus the
  `OcrEngine` interface types (OCR helpers are not vendored yet)
- `packages/font-metrics/` — installed-font location/measurement (Node fs)
- `apps/pdf/main/` — PDFium-based content-stream text/image edit, save and
  verification pipeline (`text-edit`, `image-edit`, `save-pdf`, `font-cmap`,
  `font-subset`, `wasm-path`, plus the helpers they import)
- `apps/pdf/shared/` — document-domain types from upstream `ipc.ts` (trimmed:
  shell/AI surface removed), `radicals.ts` (Unicode-derived, see
  `LICENSE-UNICODE.txt`), `x-layers.ts`
- `host/` — Cabinet-owned host adapters (`image-codec.ts` replaces Electron
  `nativeImage` with a synchronous PNG/JPEG codec; `setImageCodec` lets a host
  substitute its own)

## What is deliberately excluded

Everything under upstream `ee/`, the Electron shell, preload/renderer UI, AI
provider/agent/search/i18n packages, telemetry, updaters, OCR helper binaries
(`ocr-vision.ts`, `ocr-helper/`, `win-ocr.cs`), the pdf.js renderer layer, and
all workspace manifests/tests. No GenOffice/Genspark user-visible branding.

## Host seams

- `apps/pdf/main/image-edit.ts` imports `nativeImage` from
  `host/image-codec.ts` (adapted; was `electron`).
- `apps/pdf/main/wasm-path.ts` resolves `@embedpdf/pdfium` and `harfbuzzjs`
  wasm via `createRequire` from this file's location; packaged hosts set
  `process.resourcesPath` (Electron) or `CABINET_WASM_DIR` with the wasm files
  under `<base>/wasm/`.
- `packages/font-metrics/` reads system font directories via `node:fs` —
  host-side only, never the browser bundle.
- `apps/pdf/main/atomic-write.ts`, `save-pdf.ts`, `text-edit.ts` use
  `node:fs` — server/daemon-side only.

## Updating

1. Check out the new upstream commit in a scratch clone.
2. Re-copy the closure files (same relative paths), re-apply the adaptations
   listed in `PROVENANCE.json` (`adapted: true` entries).
3. Run `node scripts/genoffice-provenance.mjs --upstream <checkout>` to
   regenerate the manifest, then `--check --upstream <checkout>` to verify.

`PROVENANCE.json` is generated by `scripts/genoffice-provenance.mjs`;
`--check` detects local drift, undeclared adaptations and upstream changes.
